name: Rocket Fellas Inc.
review:
Rocket Fellas Inc. is a 30-line mining slot with wilds, sticky wilds, transforming symbols, a hot reel feature and free spins.

Thunderkick rates it High volatility, with a 7,325x cap and a 96.1% RTP.

Sticky wilds, transforming symbols and a hot reel can combine on the same spin, giving the 30-line base game more variety than most. The mining-explosion humour is classic Thunderkick.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
